BenchmarkResponse.title: BenchmarkResponse
BenchmarkResponse.description: What the wallet's money would be worth in `symbol` instead, at the end of every day (see the endpoint).

ContributionResponse.title: ContributionResponse
ContributionResponse.description: What one holding brought to the wallet's gain over the period, in the wallet's currency.

DailyValueResponse.title: DailyValueResponse
DailyValueResponse.description: The wallet at the end of a day, valued at that day's closing prices, in its currency.

DividendsResponse.title: DividendsResponse
DividendsResponse.description: A security's dividends: the next announced, and those of the last year.

FieldError.title: FieldError
FieldError.description: One problem in a malformed request, as FastAPI reports it.

FundamentalsResponse.title: FundamentalsResponse
FundamentalsResponse.description:
A company's reported yearly results (amounts in `currency`, oldest first) and shares outstanding, with the P/E
(against the last fiscal year's diluted EPS) and market cap at the latest price; those are null without one.

OrderOutcomeResponse.title: OrderOutcomeResponse
OrderOutcomeResponse.description: How a filled order turned out since: returns in percent, each in its own currency; null without a price.

PerformanceComparisonResponse.title: PerformanceComparisonResponse
PerformanceComparisonResponse.description:
How the wallet did over a period next to `benchmark_symbol` with the same deposits; null when nothing in the
period could be valued.

PerformanceResponse.title: PerformanceResponse
PerformanceResponse.description: How a wallet or a benchmark did over a period (see domain.performance); returns in percent.

PlaceOrderRequest.title: PlaceOrderRequest
PlaceOrderRequest.description:
An order placed now: at market, it fills at the first price after it; with a limit price, on the first later
minute that reaches it (see domain.orders).

RulesRequest.title: RulesRequest
RulesRequest.description:
The wallet's rules for orders, replaced as a whole: each a share of its whole value (0.2 for 20%), null for no
limit.

SecurityRangesResponse.title: SecurityRangesResponse
SecurityRangesResponse.description: Where the price and the P/E stand within their lows and highs over a period; null without them.

SecurityStatisticsResponse.title: SecurityStatisticsResponse
SecurityStatisticsResponse.description:
How the price moved, in percent: its trend back from today, and over the period asked for its volatility (over
a year), deepest fall and beta against `benchmark_symbol`. Each null without enough closes.

StatementRequest.title: StatementRequest
StatementRequest.description: A broker's two exports, as the files' text.

TradingActivityResponse.title: TradingActivityResponse
TradingActivityResponse.description: What the wallet traded over the period and what that cost, in its currency; percentages of its average value.
